text: The `spec-skills` row of wklad-do-edytora-m52 says each item is `/<slug>` with `label` = the skill's title, taken from the skill listing of the `chat` context type. That listing (skill-listing-response: rows `SkillListingEntry` = slug, description, origin, project?) carries no title, so the source cannot fill `label` with it without a per-skill `GET /skills/:slug` or a new listing field. Built: `label` = `/<slug>` (the visible trigger), `description` from the listing, `hint` = slug, `origin` as the marker. Either the listing rows gain an optional `title`, or the sheet's `label = tytuł` should read `label = /<slug>`.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0901 — the `chat` listing carries no title, so the label is the visible trigger `/<slug>` instead of the skill's title.
